For performance, use comparable inputs/settings and simulation/frame-time
measurements. For generated inputs, include generator/input identities, manifest
changes and semantic comparisons. Do not present automated tests or agent review
as physical-device certification or independent human review.

## Review checklist

- [ ] One purpose; unrelated formatting/refactoring excluded
- [ ] Relevant [code quality rules](../docs/CODE_QUALITY.md) followed
- [ ] Generated/imported source bytes preserved or changes explicitly justified
- [ ] Default quality, input and integrated-data launching preserved or intentional differences verified

## Rights checklist
- [ ] No game ISO/BIOS/ELF or proprietary assets
- [ ] Licensing and attribution checked
- [ ] No secrets or absolute developer-machine paths
